test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which state is the Mudumalai National Park located?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mudumalai National Park**

 
 
• Mudumalai National Park is a national park in the** Nilgiri Mountains in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It covers **321 km2** at an elevation range of **850–1,250 m** in the Nilgiri District.
 
• It shares boundaries with the states of Karnataka and Kerala.
 
• The national park has been part of **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve since 1986.**
 
• It was declared a **tiger reserve** together with a buffer zone of **367.59 km2** in 2007.
 
• It receives an **annual rainfall** of about **1,420 mm.**
 
• It is drained by the Moyar River and several tributaries, which harbor 38 fish species.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word Mudumalai is a Tamil word with **'mudhukadu'** **meaning ancient forest.**
 
• The word **'malai' means hill or mountain.**
 
• The name 'Mudumalai forest' was already in use when the British Government rented the forest in 1857 for logging purposes.
 
• In **2010,** the National Tiger Conservation Authority approved the release of funds to **Mudumalai Tiger Reserve** in the frame of Project Tiger.
 
• In **2020**, Project Tiger has been extended until 2021 with funding of ₹ **114.1 million borne.**
 
• Mudumalai National Park harbors tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests.
 
• The floral diversity comprises **498 plant species** including** 154 tree, 77 shrub, 214 herb and 53 vine species.**
